selection: Fixed final epoch only; diagnostic comparison; retain base regardless of result.
retain_trained_candidate_rule: At least two additional pilot task successes and no regression in gold-constrained route validity. This is exploratory screening, not final superiority evidence.
failure_policy: Keep every case in denominator. Stop subsequent mutations on transport failure; inspect recorded future before any continuation. Never retry a training configuration to obtain a better headline.
rationale: Owner explicitly selected exploratory retraining on 2026-10-09, Telegram2692. Three epochs, smaller batches including final15 and lower LR; combined recipe not isolated causal LR claim.
shuffle_policy: Python random.Random(epoch).shuffle over case indices; recorded exact batch IDs
